name: NJ-05
label: Safe D

key_factors: Markets price Gottheimer at ~97% to win
Gottheimer has $12.8M on hand vs. under $10K for Kirrane
District leans Democratic and Gottheimer is a well-established incumbent
model.rationale: Prediction markets put Gottheimer's win odds near 97%, and his financial advantage is overwhelming: $12.8 million on hand against roughly $8,000 for Republican Sean Kirrane. With a modestly Democratic-leaning district and an entrenched incumbent, the fundamentals point to a comfortable double-digit Democratic margin.
model.watch: Any late surge in Republican outside spending or a polling surprise showing the race inside single digits would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Josh Gottheimer seeks another term in a northern New Jersey district that leans slightly Democratic. He enters the general election with a massive resource advantage, holding more than $12.7 million in cash after raising over $4.7 million, while Republican Sean Kirrane has raised only about $56,000 and has minimal outside support. No independent general-election polls are available for this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and market pricing.

Prediction markets on both Kalshi and Polymarket price Gottheimer's chances at roughly 97 percent, consistent with a safe seat for the incumbent. The expected margin is a comfortable double-digit Democratic win, though the absence of polling leaves some room for uncertainty.
